<thought>Based on the mass spectrum (M+H = 193.11 Da) the neutral molecular weight is ~192.11 Da, corresponding to the formula C₁₂H₁₆O₂. The ¹³C NMR shows a carbonyl carbon at ~166 ppm (typical for an ester), aromatic carbons around 130 ppm (a phenyl ring), a methoxy carbon at ~52 ppm, and three aliphatic carbons (≈49, 44, 19 ppm) consistent with a –CH₂–CH₂–CH₂–CH₃ chain attached to the phenyl ring. A structure that fits these data is methyl 5‑phenylpentanoate, i.e., a phenyl‑substituted five‑carbon chain ending in a methyl ester. The SMILES for this compound is:

COC(=O)CCCCc1ccccc1

This SMILES is valid and matches the inferred formula and spectroscopic features.</thought>
